description: This Java interface defines a JPA repository for CreditReport entities, including a custom query method to retrieve credit reports based on national ID and credit bureau ID.
external_methods: Query("SELECT creditBureauReport from CreditReport creditBureauReport where creditBureauReport.nationalId = :nationalId and creditBureauReport.creditBureauId = :creditBureauId ")

classes.name: CreditReportRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing CreditReport entities with custom query capabilities.

methods.name: getThitsaWorksCreditReport
methods.description: Retrieves a CreditReport entity based on the provided credit bureau ID and national ID.
